name: PiD
description: PiD (Pixel Diffusion Decoder) is a generative model and decoding paradigm developed by NVIDIA Spatial Intelligence Lab (SIL). It reformulates latent-to-pixel decoding as a conditional pixel-space diffusion process, replacing traditional VAE decoders to unify decoding and 4x/8x spatial super-resolution into a fast 4-step distilled diffusion process.
keyFeatures: Unified latent decoding and 4x/8x spatial super-resolution directly in pixel space
Sigma-aware adapter enabling early termination of latent diffusion models
Fast 4-step distilled inference via DMD2 achieving <1s decoding at 2048x2048 resolution
Universal drop-in replacement compatible with standard VAE, SigLIP, and DINOv2 latents
High visual fidelity and sharp detail synthesis avoiding blurriness of traditional VAE decoders
curatorNotes: Verified paper arXiv:2605.23902 and open-source implementation from NVIDIA SIL.
